On the fourth advance publish new quotient/remainder, busy=0,done=1. A start simultaneous with that fourth advance is ignored (OLD busy). No implicit extra advance at acceptance. Falling/stable clock changes hold all output; reset assertion clears immediately, release alone does not act.
